Forwarding Acme’s ask — quick summary and my take below.

Summary: Acme requests 20% off first year in exchange for co-marketing (blog, quote, webinar). Timeline: publish week of Dec 6. Attachments: MA plan + marketing brief.

My recommendation: approve a marketing-for-credit trade but cap concession to 15% (or $X credit) not 20%; require editorial review/approval on all assets, a 6-month embargo on any in-depth case study that includes metrics, and limited usage rights (logo + short quote only; no filmed testimonial or exclusivity). Also insist on a published byline that mentions Redwood as a partner.

Can marketing/legal confirm we’re comfortable with scope? If yes, I’ll communicate terms to Acme and get DocuSign T&Cs attached.

Thanks — Jonas

Jonas — thanks for the concise rec. A few quick items before we greenlight any pricing exception:

1) Marketing: can you confirm the exact deliverables and ownership/approval workflow? We need final sign-off rights and a single point of contact from Acme.
2) Legal: Laura, do we have any standard publicity contract templates that cover embargo, scope, and no-exclusive clauses? Also want to ensure we aren’t granting rights to reuse Redwood IP in marketing.
3) Finance: if we move to 15% vs 20%, confirm impact on ARR targets for Q4 and whether we need formal MCPA approval.

If marketing/legal are comfortable with the constraints Jonas suggested (15%, logo+quote only, 6-month embargo, no video/testimonial), I’m willing to approve on principle — final sign-off contingent on a short mutual-action doc and DocuSign.

-Vivek

Vivek/Jonas —

Marketing has reviewed Acme’s brief and the proposed assets. We can accept the trade with the following binding conditions:

- Concession: 15% off first-year subscription (applied as an invoice credit capped at $85k). No additional discounts.
- Publicity scope: Redwood grants non-exclusive rights to display Redwood logo, publish a short customer highlight (100–150 words) and a single pull-quote (authorized by Acme).
- Disallowed: recorded video testimonials, customer metrics highlighted as Redwood-attributed case metrics, or any use implying exclusivity.
- Timing: Drafts of all assets to be delivered to Redwood 14 days before publish. Redwood editorial has final approval; approvals should not be unreasonably withheld.
- Embargo: No detailed technical case study including performance numbers for 6 months after go-live. High-level joint announcement allowed at launch.
- Legal/Sign-off: Laura to attach the standard publicity addendum (redwood_publicity_template.pdf).

If legal signs off on the addendum, I approve the 15% credit and we can proceed. Jonas — please update Acme with these terms and send over the contact for DocuSign. I’ll coordinate marketing assets and the webinar slot on Dec 9 (preferred).

Thanks — Marissa
